tickerText: [TENNIS] Mirra Andreeva beat Aliaksandra Sasnovich 6-2, 6-2 on Sept. 23 to reach the Singapore Open quarterfinals against Leylah Fernandez, while Alex Eala opens her WTA 500 campaign vs Tatiana Prozorova on Sept. 24 and the ATP-WTA Asian Swing fills four cities from Chengdu to Seoul • [SQUASH] Top seed Eain Yow opened his Asian Games title defense with an 11-2, 11-1, 11-2 win over Reymark Begornia in 19 minutes on Sept. 23, as Nagoya singles play doubles as Olympic LA28 qualifiers with Tanvi Khanna facing Au Yeong Wai Yhann in the women's round of 16 • [BADMINTON] China and Indonesia meet in the men's team final on Sept. 24 at Ichinomiya after 3-1 semifinal wins over India and Thailand, while China's women face host Japan for gold following a 3-0 rout of Indonesia and Japan's 3-1 win over South Korea • [PICKLEBALL] The Carvana PPA Tour unveiled the Junior PPA Select Team pathway on Sept. 22, with 18u and 14u squads chosen after the Nov. 5-8 Junior World Championships and training launching Jan. 1, 2027, as the tour eyes the Sept. 28 Rate Las Vegas Open • [TABLE TENNIS] China and Japan clash in both men's and women's team finals on Sept. 24 in Nagoya after semifinal sweeps, while India's Sreeja Akula-Syndrela Das and Yashaswini Ghorpade-Diya Chitale reached women's doubles pre-quarters with 3-0 wins

newsItems.title: China-Japan TT Finals
newsItems.excerpt: China's men's and women's teams face host Japan in both Asian Games team finals on Sept. 24 in Nagoya after sweeping their semifinals on Sept. 23, with Harimoto, Matsushima and Togami powering Japan's men past South Korea.

newsItems.title: Andreeva Meets Fernandez
newsItems.excerpt: Top seed Mirra Andreeva reached the Singapore Open quarterfinals with a 6-2, 6-2 win over Aliaksandra Sasnovich on Sept. 23, setting up a rubber-match showdown with Leylah Fernandez as both chase WTA Finals points.

newsItems.title: Eain Yow Cruises in Nagoya
newsItems.excerpt: Malaysia's Eain Yow began defending his Asian Games squash title on Sept. 23 with an 11-2, 11-1, 11-2 rout of the Philippines' Reymark Begornia in 19 minutes, as singles gold medalists earn direct LA28 Olympic berths.

newsItems.title: Junior PPA Select Team
newsItems.excerpt: The Carvana Junior PPA Tour announced the Junior PPA Select Team on Sept. 22, naming 18u and 14u players after the Opendoor Junior World Championships in Dallas and launching elite coaching and tour exposure on Jan. 1, 2027.
